title: Add task management as multi-agent coordination infrastructure
description: Task management systems like Taskulus/Beads enable stepping back from pair programming to manager/delegator role. Without them, you're stuck in interactive sessions. With them, you can delegate to multiple agents like managing contractors. This is critical infrastructure for scaling beyond 1:1 chat interactions.
notes: Added 'Task Management: From Pair Programming to Delegation' subsection in WIP section. Explains how task management systems enable scaling from interactive chat to parallel delegation across multiple agents. Links to Taskulus and Beads. Committed in 444004f.

title: Third article: Maximize Value, Not Intelligence
description:
Add a third draft article to the AI-coding-economics set, on the skyrocketing value of coding models.

Practical/buyer-guide in nature, aimed at solo developers and small businesses. Sequel to the 2023 article 'Maximize Profit, Not Intelligence'.

Companions:
- src/blog/ai-coding-cost-collapse-2026.mdx (The Year Coding Became a Commodity)

comments.author: Ryan Alyn Porter
comments.text:
Draft complete and verified rendering on gatsby develop.

CREATED

MODIFIED

- bugonomics-cheap-exploits-2026.mdx: removed the Jevons Paradox section (cheaper attacks -> more attacks is not a paradox), replaced with 'Volume is the threat'. Fixed LiL taxonomy citation to arXiv 2605.28893. Added companion links.

VERIFIED
- All 4 articles return 200 on gatsby develop; MDX compiles clean
- 4 HTML tables render (site has no GFM/table CSS - see open items)
- 12 marks, 14 references, all cross-links resolve

OPEN ITEMS FOR AUTHOR
1. bugonomics still cites arXiv 2606.13995v1 (= Dialogue SWE-Bench, wrong paper) for 3 claims: the 4-vuln sandbox escape, the 500k-findings dataset, and the agentjacking/Sentry narrative. The named paper 'The Intersection of AI and Vulnerability Chaining' does not appear to exist. Needs a real source or removal.
2. bugonomics '10.8% drop in patch rates' unverified; source paper reports 28.57% Pass@1 for prompt-injection repairs.
3. Site-wide: no remark-gfm, so Markdown tables never render. The cost-collapse Dialogue-SWEBench table currently shows as raw pipes.

comments.author: Ryan Alyn Porter
comments.text:
Phase 2 complete and verified on a clean-cache gatsby develop.

CITATION REPAIR (bugonomics)
Fabricated source 'The Intersection of AI and Vulnerability Chaining' (arxiv 2606.13995v1) removed entirely. All claims it carried turned out to be REAL - only the citation was invented. Re-attributed to primary sources:
- Anthropic, 'Assessing Claude Mythos Preview cybersecurity capabilities' (2026-04-07) - thousands of vulns, 4-vuln JIT-heap-spray browser chain, 20-gadget ROP chain vs FreeBSD NFS
- Praetorian, 'From 500K Findings to 14 That Matter' - 500k findings -> 14 endpoints, ~35,000:1 signal-to-noise
- Cloud Security Alliance (2026-06-14) - Agentjacking/Sentry MCP; added the 85% exploitation success rate and the real credential list
- Added tenet-security/agent-jackstop + deny-by-default egress as the concrete mitigation

10.8% FIGURE: was CORRECT as written - my earlier flag was wrong. arXiv 2605.28893 abstract reports a 10.8-point average Pass@1 drop. Citation now attached; added the 0%-repair categories.

GFM TABLES (site-wide)
- Installed remark-gfm@3.0.1 exact (v4 breaks gatsby-plugin-mdx v5, gatsbyjs/gatsby#38789)
- gatsby-config.js -> gatsby-config.mjs (ESM required; __dirname shimmed via fileURLToPath; mdxOptions.remarkPlugins added). Diff verified as ONLY those changes.
- Table CSS moved from a scoped block in the MDX into src/components/layout.scss (site had zero table styling)
- New article's 4 tables converted back to Markdown

VERIFIED
- Clean-cache rebuild, no errors
- New article: 4 real tables, styled, no leftover style block
- cost-collapse Dialogue-SWEBench table renders for the first time; rubrics + cybernetic-development tables now live
- domain-specific-turn-detection pipe block correctly left as <pre> (intentional code fence)
- proven-llm-techniques bare arXiv URL now autolinks
- No strikethrough regressions (no ~~ in any article)
- package-lock churn is a healthy dedup: old remark-gfm@1 tree (147 nested entries) replaced by 3.0.1 (75)

comments.author: Ryan Alyn Porter
comments.text:
Shipped. Production build verified clean before merge (4 tables in the new article's built HTML, cost-collapse table building, no fabricated citation in output).

title: Revise IaC section to acknowledge Terraform, CloudFormation, etc before CDK
